Deterministic front/depth fit contract, applied separately to each material, profile, mask, and digitization scenario: retain rows in point_index order and partition at every nonconsecutive point_index; require strictly increasing finite x inside each block. For a reference row define independent unit g as its nonempty shared_group, otherwise material:point_index; for n_g retained rows in unit g set each row weight w_i=1/n_g, so every independent unit has total weight one. Sample a simulated PLX only at the retained scenario-specific reference x values by linear interpolation in (x,log10(C)) between adjacent positive finite native nodes, with no extrapolation or interpolation across a missing/nonfinite native interval, and inherit the reference row weights and gaps. Enumerate b1<b2 from midpoints of pairs of retained rows that are consecutive in point_index within a block. With front x<=b1, transition b1<x<=b2, and tail x>b2, accept a pair only when front and tail each contain at least two distinct independent units and the transition contains at least three rows forming two consecutive point_index increments within one block. Fit the continuous model f(x)=a+sF*(x-b1) for x<=b1; f(x)=a+sT*(x-b1) for b1<x<=b2; and f(x)=a+sT*(b2-b1)+sR*(x-b2) for x>b2. Minimize Q=sum_i w_i*(log10(C_i)-f(x_i))^2 subject only to the decreasing-transition constraint sT<=0; for each breakpoint pair use IEEE-754 binary64 weighted QR with columns ordered (a,sF,sT,sR), retain the unconstrained solution when sT<=0, otherwise refit with sT fixed to zero, and reject a rank-deficient or nonfinite candidate. Select the lowest Q; candidates within 16*machine_epsilon*max(1,abs(Q_min)) are tied and the unique tie-break is smallest b1 then smallest b2. Report b1 as transition start, (b1+b2)/2 as front midpoint, b2 as operational doping-depth endpoint, width b2-b1, sF/sT/sR in decade/um, Q and sqrt(Q/sum_i w_i), support units, and primary-minus-reference differences in um. Failure of any enumerability, rank, positivity, or finite-value condition is not determinable.

Deterministic aligned-trace contract for each reference-versus-own-anchor primary and reference-versus-own-anchor tight pair: from each accepted fit compute the weighted front-row centroid xF=sum(w_i*x_i)/sum(w_i), front level LF=f(xF), aligned depth u=x-(b1+b2)/2 in um, and normalized log level z=log10(C)-LF. Represent each curve only by linear interpolation in (u,z) inside intervals joining adjacent retained rows/nodes; a reference interval exists only for consecutive point_index rows, and no source is extrapolated. Let u_min=max of the two curves' minimum supported u and u_max=min of their maximum supported u. If u_max<=u_min, report not determinable; otherwise create exactly 257 candidate grid points u_j=u_min+j*(u_max-u_min)/256 for j=0,...,256, including both endpoints. At every candidate report u_j, each curve's interpolation status, and r_j=z_sim(u_j)-z_ref(u_j) only when both values lie in valid support intervals; report null residual with the specific gap/outside/nonfinite status otherwise. Never interpolate across a point_index gap: assign consecutive valid grid points to separate trace_segment_id values on either side, and retain all 257 grid records. If fewer than two valid residual points remain, the aligned trace is not determinable. Report this full trace together with fitted transition width, sT, sF, and sR. Whole-domain log10 MSE or WRMSE may be reported only as an auxiliary residual-size summary and cannot replace the trace.
